capabilities: Share a folder through an invite link
Edit notes and canvases together in real time
Set read, write and delete permissions per user
Keep file version history and restore deleted files
Link a shared folder to a local folder on desktop
extras: Requires installing a separate self-hosted server first; linking a shared folder to a folder outside the vault is desktop-only, and files deleted there go to the system trash.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to edit the same folder with other people in real time while keeping the files encrypted and on your own server.
summary: Self-hosted plugin that shares vault folders with other users in real time, with end-to-end encryption and per-user read, write and delete permissions.
